name: rovas-connector
description: VS Code extension for reporting programming time to Rovas.

rovas-connector.projectId.description: Project ID (parent project for the created work reports). To manage your Project ID history, use the 'Rovas Connector: Manage Project IDs' command from the Command Palette.

rovas-connector.pauseWhenIdle.description: Pause the timer after a period with no editor activity (typing, selection, scroll). Off by default because Cursor Chat/Agent input is not detectable as editor activity. The timer still pauses when Cursor is in the background.

rovas-connector.inactivityTimeout.description: When “Pause when idle” is enabled: seconds without editor activity before the timer pauses.

rovas-connector.paidStatus.description: I am not paid for my programming work by a company (only prompted to send a work report if this is confirmed).

rovas-connector.usageFeeInfo.description: Usage fee: The plugin charges a 3% fee on every report sent. This fee will be subtracted from the Chron earnings you receive for the time reported in your work reports. The fee Chrons are immediately converted to Merits and assigned to the Rovas Connector for Code project.

rovas-connector.reportEvents.description: Events that trigger the Rovas work report dialog. Currently only 'onCommit' is supported.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
